appearance_facts.fact: A large, solid light-blue rectangular region fills the vertical space between the top axis limit (0) and the data line near the bottom.
A dark blue line with circular markers connects data points across the horizontal axis from 2006 to 2018.
The axis is labeled 'Year' and displays tick marks for 2006, 2008, 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, and 2018.
The axis is labeled 'Count' and is inverted, with 0 at the top and 8 at the bottom.
The line fluctuates slightly but generally remains near the bottom of the chart (high Count values) across all years.
The marker for the year 2010 is positioned slightly higher on the page (lower Count value, closer to 8) than the markers for 2006, 2008, and 2012.
The marker for the year 2018 is positioned at the lowest point on the page (highest Count value, furthest from 0) compared to all other years shown.
The line segment from 2015 to 2018 shows a downward trend on the page, moving away from the 0 mark and towards the 8 mark.

public_definitions: The task asks to 'route the year that should receive peak-burden follow-up' based on the 'yearly mortality trend in the chart'.
uncertain: The chart title says 'Mortality rate' but the Y-axis is labeled 'Count', creating a slight ambiguity in the metric name.
The Y-axis is inverted (0 at top, 8 at bottom), which is non-standard for 'rate' or 'count' visualizations, making 'peak' visually ambiguous (highest on page vs highest value).
